title: Tax carried interest fully as income
headline: Tax fund managers’ carried interest as income at 45%: CenTax’s central case, £0.5bn.
description: Carried interest is the share of a fund’s profits paid to private equity and hedge fund managers. Since April 2026 it is charged to income tax, but on a reduced basis rather than at the full 45% other income bears. Tax Justice UK, citing CenTax’s central post-behavioural estimate on the 2025-26 tax base, puts the yield from equalising it fully with the top rate of income tax at £510 million a year, after the 2024 Budget changes. Held flat in cash here; it arrives as income tax.

baselinePolicy.text: The October 2024 Budget removed carried interest from the capital gains tax base and moved it into income tax from April 2026, on a reduced basis. CenTax’s 2026 re-costing of its CGT package therefore excludes it.

source.quote: removed carried interest from the CGT base

alreadyIncludes: The 2024 Budget’s move of carried interest into income tax from April 2026.

terms.label: CenTax’s central post-behavioural estimate for equalising carried interest with the top rate of income tax, as cited by Tax Justice UK

source.quote: to raise an additional £510 million per year

rawSource.note: Tax Justice UK’s figure, which it attributes to CenTax’s central case on the 2025-26 static tax base after the 2024 Budget changes; held flat in cash from the start year. CenTax’s own carried-interest paper is not registered here.

caveats: A campaign group’s citation of CenTax’s central case, on the 2025-26 base and after the 2024 Budget changes; CenTax’s own paper is quoted second-hand. Small, and concentrated on a few thousand people.
Held flat in cash: fund performance moves carried interest a great deal from year to year.

considerations.text: CenTax’s central case already includes a behavioural response; fund managers are mobile, and a harsher response would cut the figure further.
A very small number of very well-paid fund managers pay; Tax Justice UK puts them at about 0.01% of the population.

interactions.text: CenTax’s 2026 package excludes carried interest, so the two cards do not overlap.
